newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London firm, NTT features.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London firm, NTT features.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London advanced on Wednesday as overnight rallies in Tokyo and New York allied to strong index futures markets boosted shares, dealers said.

The Nikkei 50 index closed up 5.83 points at 1,544.90 in London. Earlier in the day the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo powered 480.75 points higher to close at 189,151.12 and Nikkei futures on SIMEX surged 765 points to close at 19,380, their highest level since January 6.

Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp featured strongly as Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) added the stock to its Japan index at a market capitalisation of 0.8 per cent, effective after the market closing on May 30. Nippon's shares jumped 75 yen to 970 yen, a rise of nearly eight per cent from its Tokyo close.
